BacktestFlip.description: One league's patient flips under one fill model. Money in Divines.
BacktestFlip.title: BacktestFlip

BacktestFlipSettings.description:
How the patient flips were placed (analysis/flips.py): bid and ask as a share of
the entry hour's range (0 its lowest trade, 1 its highest), the hourly ask cut.
BacktestFlipSettings.title: BacktestFlipSettings

BacktestHourly.description:
One hourly strategy in one stretch of a league, at fair or harsh prices.
Profits are in Divines.
BacktestHourly.title: BacktestHourly

BacktestLaunch.description: A league traded with the Launch picks ranked from the leagues before it.
BacktestLaunch.title: BacktestLaunch

BacktestLimit.description:
The recap's top card turn-ins or loops traded with orders priced from its hour, in
one stretch of a league. Profits are in Divines.
BacktestLimit.title: BacktestLimit

FarmingHours.description:
Hour-of-day profiles from past leagues for the league's phase (a constant): 24
values each by UTC hour, a price's fraction over its centred 24-hour average.
FarmingHours.title: FarmingHours

FarmingImpact.description:
Finding 7: no calibrated price drop (`y` null); a stack is shown as hours of the
market's trading (Q / volume_h), banded at `bands`.
FarmingImpact.title: FarmingImpact

FarmingMarket.description:
One market's recent trading for an item: `price` in that market's currency
(Chaos, or Divines in the Divine market; median, latest 24 hours), units traded an
hour, the typical hourly swing (informative only) and the share of hours traded
(latest 3 days).
FarmingMarket.title: FarmingMarket

FarmingMechanic.description:
A mechanic's basket now (finding 8). The index is in Divines, over the basket's
day-0 prices; `usual` and its range are past leagues' at the same day of the league
(null after day 13 or with fewer than 2 past leagues).
FarmingMechanic.title: FarmingMechanic

HourEffect.description:
What timing is worth in a price profile (finding 6), as fractions of the price:
best hour over the 24-hour average (`gain`) and over the worst (`gap`), UTC hours,
the noise floor (`null95`); "small" means time of day barely matters.
HourEffect.title: HourEffect

MissedFlip.description:
A volatile flip from the latest hour: bid `bid` (Chaos) low in its range, list at
`ask` and cut it by `cut` each hour it doesn't sell. tries / through / chance: how
often the same flip went through in the last 72 hours (optimistic fills).
MissedFlip.title: MissedFlip

OutlookWindow.description:
The launch premium in a window: its median Divine price over days 12–14's,
recency-weighted over past leagues (`premium`), and the lowest league's (`worst`).
OutlookWindow.title: OutlookWindow

Upcoming.description: The announced next league, until its first trades are loaded.
Upcoming.title: Upcoming

get.description:
Would following the site's tools have paid? The backtest's report (one item; empty
until `eb backtest run` has been run on the research database and seeded).

schema.title: Response Backtest Report Api Backtest Get

get.description:
Mechanics ranked on their trend against past leagues' usual path, the launch
outlook and Easy to sell; the basket items' recent trading in each market; the hour
of day and stack-impact constants. Before the league's first trades, the outlook
only. Prices in Chaos (Divines for the Divine market): convert with `/api/status`.

What to buy in each early-league window, ranked from past leagues (empty until
`eb launch picks` has been run on the research database and seeded).

schema.title: Response Picks Api Launch Picks Get

get.description:
What the latest 1, 2 and 3 published hours offered: key movers, volatile items
and the loops and card turn-ins that left the most on the table. All three
look-backs at once (a few KB), computed once per loaded hour.

schema.title: Response Missed Opportunities Api Missed  League  Get

get.description:
Leagues on the exchange, newest data first, the data version, and the announced
next league until it has trades. Cheap: poll this, and refetch everything else when
`data_version` changes.
